facts.content: Acute uncomplicated cystitis (simple UTI) diagnosed with 3 days of dysuria, mild suprapubic cramps with voiding, malodor, and brief hematuria.
facts.source_text: Assessment: 1) Acute uncomplicated cystitis (simple UTI) — 3 days dysuria, mild suprapubic cramps with voiding, malodor, brief hematuria;

facts.content: Prescribe Nitrofurantoin or Trimethoprim, 1 tablet twice daily for 3 days.
facts.source_text: Abx: Nitrofurantoin or Trimethoprim 1 tab BID x 3 days

facts.content: Advise hydration and consider cranberry juice for symptom relief.

facts.content: Instruct patient to return or call if not improved by the end of the week or if experiencing fever, back/flank pain, or systemic unwellness.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: Return/call if not improved by end of week or if fever, back/flank pain, or systemic unwellness (concern for ascending infection)

facts.content: Advise to avoid intercourse until symptoms resolve and to continue using barrier contraception.
facts.source_text: Sexual activity: Avoid intercourse until symptoms resolve; continue barrier contraception

facts.content: Suggest performing a pregnancy test if concerned or symptoms persist.
